t: You're looking at a memorial tree in Covent Garden, set here in remembrance of Anne Frank. She was a German-born Jewish girl who kept a diary during the German occupation of the Netherlands. In it she described everyday life in her family's hiding place, a secret annex in Amsterdam, from 1942 until their arrest in 1944. She died in 1945, aged fifteen. Her diary made her known around the world after her death, and this tree commemorates her.
